about: Weekly lessons for the Painted Shacks owner app: 104 weeks (two years) in 13 terms of 8 weeks, 7 lessons and 1 review week (Phinda) each. Based on the isiXhosa Bitcoin Diploma book by My First Bitcoin (CC BY-SA 4.0), split into smaller parts. Term 1 (weeks 1-8) is written; the other weeks have a title and book section only and are written term by term. Every lesson imports as a DRAFT: an admin checks the isiXhosa and the answers, then publishes. A review week has no questions of its own: its quiz uses the questions of that term's lessons. Pictures are taken from the same book (CC BY-SA 4.0).

lessons.title: Intshayelelo: le khosi ne-app zisebenza njani
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 1
lessons.body:
# Siyakwamkela!

Siyakwamkela kwi-Bitcoin Diploma yePainted Shacks. Esi sisifundo sakho sokuqala.

Imali siyisebenzisa yonke imihla: xa sithenga isonka, xa sihlawula iteksi, xa sithengisa kwi-spaza. Kule khosi siza kufunda ukuba yintoni kanye imali, ukuba isebenza njani, kwaye yintoni i-Bitcoin.

> "Imali sesona sixhobo singundoqo sokukhulula abantu." – Friedrich Hayek

---

# Le khosi isebenza njani

Le khosi ineeveki eziyi-104, oko kukuthi iminyaka emibini.

- Iiveki zahlulwe zaba **ziikota ezili-13**. Ikota nganye ineeveki ezisi-8.
- Kwikota nganye kukho **izifundo ezisi-7** ezifutshane.
- Iveki yesi-8 yeyo**Phinda**: akukho sifundo sitsha, uphendula imibuzo esuka kwizifundo zale kota.

Isifundo ngasinye sifutshane. Ungasifunda efowunini yakho xa uphumle kancinci.

---

# I-app isebenza njani

1. Vula isifundo seveki, ufunde iphepha ngalinye ukuya esiphelweni.
2. Cofa **"Ndigqibile ukufunda"**.
3. Phendula **imibuzo emi-4**. Kufuneka uphendule **emi-3 ngokuchanekileyo**.
4. Ukuba awuphumelelanga, funda kwakhona uze uzame kwakhona.

Isifundo esilandelayo sivuleka ngoMvulo emva kokuba ugqibe esi. Isifundo esinye ngeveki.

---

# Iisats zakho

Xa ugqibe isifundo sale veki nemibuzo yaso, ufumana **7,000 sats**.

- Iisats zihlawulwa kanye ngenyanga, **ngoLwesihlanu lokugqibela** lwenyanga, kwidilesi yakho ye-Lightning.
- Kwinyanga ufumana ukuya kuthi ga kwi-**28,000 sats** (iiveki ezi-4).
- I-shack yakho kufuneka icoceke xa ihlolwa.

> Funda isifundo esinye ngeveki. Ungalibali!

choices: Uphendula imibuzo esuka kwizifundo zale kota

lessons.title: Dibana noSatoshi: imibuzo emihlanu ngemali
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 1.1
lessons.body:
# Dibana noSatoshi

Molo! NdinguSatoshi. Ndiza kuhamba nawe kwesi sifundo se-Bitcoin Diploma.

Kwiiveki ezizayo siza kufunda:
- ukuba yintoni imali nokuba isebenza njani
- imbali yemali ukusuka kudala ukuya namhlanje
- ukuba yintoni i-Bitcoin nokuba ungayisebenzisa njani
- indlela yokugcina iisats zakho zikhuselekile

---

# Imibuzo emihlanu ngemali

Ngaphambi kokuba siqhubeke, cinga ngale mibuzo mihlanu. Cinga ngezinto zokwenyani ebomini bakho, ezifana nokutya nezinto ozithengayo yonke imihla.

1. Kutheni sifuna imali?
2. Yintoni imali?
3. Ngubani olawula imali?
4. Yintoni eyenza imali ibe nexabiso?
5. Ngowuphi umbuzo onawo wena ngemali?

---

# Akukho mpendulo ingachanekanga

Apha akukho mpendulo ilungileyo okanye ingalunganga. Le mibuzo yeyokuba ucinge.

Gcina iimpendulo zakho engqondweni, okanye uzibhale phantsi. Siza kubuyela kule mibuzo ekupheleni kwekhosi, siza kubona ukuba izimvo zakho zitshintshe njani.

> Umbuzo olungileyo sisiqalo sokufunda.

questions.question: Igama lomntu oza kuhamba nawe kwesi sifundo ngubani?
Kule veki ucinge ngemibuzo emingaphi ngemali?
Yeyiphi kwezi ingeyiyo enye yemibuzo emihlanu ngemali?
Kule mibuzo emihlanu, ingaba zikhona iimpendulo ezingalunganga?
Siza kubuyela nini kule mibuzo emihlanu?
Yintoni enye esiza kufunda ngayo kule khosi?

lessons.title: Kutheni sifuna imali?
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 1.2
lessons.body:
# Kutheni sifuna imali?

Khawucinge ngosuku lwakho. Ufuna ukutya, amanzi, umbane, iimpahla, uthutho. Akukho mntu unokwenza zonke ezi zinto yedwa.

Ngoko siyatshintshiselana: ndenza into enye, wena wenza enye, size sitshintshiselane.

---

# Imali isinceda ntoni?

Imali isinceda:
- **sithenge** izinto esizidingayo kwabanye abantu
- **sithengise** esikwenzayo okanye esinako
- **songe** ngoku ukuze sibe nento ngomso
- **sazi ixabiso** lezinto, size sithelekise

Umzekelo: umnini-spaza uthengisa isonka ngemali, emva koko uthenga isitokhwe esitsha ngaloo mali.

---

# Kutheni singenakwenza imali ngokwethu?

Kutheni singenakusuka sikhabe ilitye kuvele imali? Kuba imali ibaluleke kuba **ayifumaneki lula**.

Ukuba wonke umntu ebenokwenza imali ngokulula, ibingayi kuba nexabiso. Siza kufunda ngakumbi ngale nto kwiiveki ezizayo.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

> Imali sisixhobo esisinceda sitshintshiselane ngezinto, songe, kwaye sazi ixabiso lezinto.

Kwiveki ezayo siza kufunda indlela yokugcina iisats zakho zikhuselekile, kuba uza kuqala ukufumana iisats kule nyanga.

lessons.title: Gcina iisats zakho zikhuselekile
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 7.5, 7.6 no-8.4 (isifundo esifutshane sokhuseleko, phambi kwentlawulo yokuqala)
lessons.body:
# Iisats zakho zezakho

Kule nyanga uza kufumana iisats zakho zokuqala kwi-wallet yakho ye-Lightning. Phambi koko, masifunde izinto ezintathu zokuzigcina zikhuselekile.

Kamva kwekhosi siza kufunda ngakumbi ngee-wallet ne-Lightning. Esi sisifundo esifutshane sokuqala.

---

# 1. Ibinzana-mfihlo lakho

[[picture:bd25-w15-2]]

Xa uvula i-wallet, ihlala ikunika **amagama ali-12 okanye ama-24**. Eli **libinzana-mfihlo** lakho (seed phrase).

- **Libhale phantsi ephepheni**, uligcine kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.
- Ungalifoti, ungalibeki kwi-WhatsApp.
- Ukuba ifowuni yakho ilahlekile, la magama abuyisa iisats zakho kwifowuni entsha.

---

# 2. Ungaze ulinike mntu

Ukuba umntu ufumana ibinzana-mfihlo lakho, angathatha **zonke** iisats zakho.

> Umntu okucela ibinzana-mfihlo **ulisela**, nokuba uthi uvela kwiBitcoin Ekasi.

IBitcoin Ekasi ayisoze ikucele ibinzana-mfihlo lakho okanye i-PIN yakho. Sidinga kuphela **idilesi yakho ye-Lightning** ukuze sikuthumelele iisats.

---

# 3. Hlola kabini phambi kokuthumela

Xa uthumela iisats, hlola **imali** kunye **nedilesi** kakuhle. Intlawulo ye-Lightning **ayibuyi**.

Ungathembi namnye, qinisekisa kuqala:
- khuphela i-app ye-wallet kuphela kwi-Google Play okanye App Store
- ungacofi amakhonkco ongawaziyo
- umntu othembisa ukuphinda-phinda iisats zakho ulisela

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

- Bhala ibinzana-mfihlo ephepheni, uligcine likhuselekile.
- Ungaze ulinike mntu. Ocela lona ulisela.
- IBitcoin Ekasi idinga idilesi yakho ye-Lightning kuphela.
- Hlola kabini, thumela kanye. Intlawulo ayibuyi.

Kufuneka uligcine njani ibinzana-mfihlo?

Ukuba uthumele iisats kwidilesi engalunganga, ziyabuya?

Kufuneka uyikhuphele phi i-app ye-wallet?
choices: Kwi-Google Play okanye App Store kuphela

lessons.title: Inkcazelo yemali
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 2.0–2.1
lessons.body:
# Yintoni imali?

> "Imali sisiqinisekiso sokuba singanayo le nto siza kuyifuna." – Aristotle

Wakhe wazibuza ukuba yintoni kanye imali? Abaninzi bethu bayakwazi ukuyisebenzisa, kodwa abaninzi abazi ukuba ivela phi okanye isebenza njani.

**Imali sisixhobo sokunaniselana ngeempahla neenkonzo.** Ichaza ixabiso lezinto ukwenzela kube lula ukurhweba.

---

# Imali sisivumelwano

Imali sisivumelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba iqela labantu livumelana ukusebenzisa into ethile ukuhlawula, loo nto iba yimali.

Umzekelo: ukuba sonke ekasi sivumelana ukuba sihlawule ngeetshokoleyithi, iitshokoleyithi ziba yimali yethu. (Kodwa ziyanyibilika elangeni, ngoko aziyiyo imali elungileyo!)

---

# Unaniselwano

**Unaniselwano** kukutshintshiselana ngeempahla okanye iinkonzo phakathi kwabantu ababini okanye ngaphezulu.

Umzekelo: uthenga isangweji evenkileni. Unika imali, ufumana isangweji.

> Imali inemisebenzi emithathu. Kwiiveki ezimbini ezizayo siza kufunda ngayo nganye.

questions.question: Imali sisixhobo sokwenza ntoni?
Yintoni eyenza into ibe yimali?

Yintoni unaniselwano?

questions.question: Ngubani owathi 'Imali sisiqinisekiso sokuba singanayo le nto siza kuyifuna'?
Imali inemisebenzi emingaphi?

lessons.title: Umsebenzi 1: isixhobo sokutshintshiselana
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 2.2
lessons.body:
# Umsebenzi 1: Isixhobo sokutshintshiselana

Umsebenzi wokuqala wemali kukusinceda sitshintshiselane ngezinto.

[[picture:bd25-w02-1]]

---

# Ngaphandle kwemali

Ngaphandle kwemali, ukuba wena unemifuno kwaye ufuna isonka, kufuneka ufumane umntu onesonka **ofuna imifuno**.

Kunzima! Mhlawumbi umntu onesonka ufuna isepha, hayi imifuno. Ngoku kufuneka ufumane umntu onesepha ofuna imifuno...

---

# Ngemali

Ngemali akunyanzelekanga ukuba ukhangele umntu ofuna kanye le nto unayo.

1. Uthengisa imifuno yakho ngemali, kuye nabani na oyifunayo.
2. Uthenga isonka ngaloo mali, kuye nabani na onaso.

> Imali yenza ukurhweba kube lula.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

Imali **sisixhobo sokutshintshiselana**: sithenga, sithengise ngayo, singakhangeli umntu ofuna kanye le nto sinayo.

Umzekelo: uSipho uthenga isonka nge-R20 kwi-spaza. Lo ngumsebenzi wokuqala wemali.

Ngaphandle kwemali, yintoni enzima xa ufuna ukurhweba?
choices: Ukufumana umntu onale nto uyifunayo kwaye ofuna le nto unayo

Ngowuphi umsebenzi wokuqala wemali esifunde ngawo?

lessons.title: Umsebenzi 2 no-3: iyunithi ye-akhawunti nokugcina ixabiso
lessons.source: Bitcoin Diploma: IMfundo ngeziMali ngeXesha le-Bitcoin (isiXhosa, 2025), My First Bitcoin, CC BY-SA 4.0, Isahluko 2.2
lessons.body:
# Umsebenzi 2: Iyunithi ye-akhawunti

Imali sisilinganiso esivunywa ngumntu wonke. Isinceda sichaze kwaye sithelekise amaxabiso.

Umzekelo: xa uthenga ifowuni, ungathelekisa amaxabiso ezivenkile ezahlukeneyo ngoko nangoko, kuba onke abhalwe **ngeerandi**.

---

# Ngaphandle kweyunithi

Ukuba ibingekho le yunithi, bekuza kufuneka uthelekise ngezinto ezahlukeneyo:

"Le fowuni ixabisa iinkukhu ezi-3 okanye iingxowa zomgubo ezi-2?"

Kunzima kakhulu! Iyunithi enye yenza ukuba sibale, sithelekise, kwaye sibhale amatyala lula.

---

# Umsebenzi 3: Ukugcina ixabiso

Imali elungileyo kufuneka **igcine ixabiso layo ixesha elide**. Ngolo hlobo ungonga namhlanje uze uthenge ngomso.

Le nto inceda abantu bacwangcisele ikamva: ukonga kwesikolo sabantwana, ukwakha, okanye ukuqala ishishini.

Ukuba imali ilahlekelwa lixabiso ngokukhawuleza, ukonga kunzima. Siza kufunda ngakumbi ngale nto kamva.

---

# Okubalulekileyo kule veki

Imali inemisebenzi emithathu:
- **Isixhobo sokutshintshiselana**: sithenga, sithengise ngayo
- **Iyunithi ye-akhawunti**: sibala, sithelekise amaxabiso ngayo
- **Igcina ixabiso**: songa ngayo ngoku ngenxa yangomso

Umzekelo: uThandi wonga inxalenye yomvuzo wakhe ukuze athenge isitovu kwinyanga ezayo. Lo ngumsebenzi wokugcina ixabiso.

Ngaphandle kweyunithi ye-akhawunti, kunzima ukwenza ntoni?

Yeyiphi kwezi engeyiyo omnye wemisebenzi emithathu yemali?

> Ukuphinda kunceda ukuba ukhumbule. Phendula ezi-3 kwemi-4 ngokuchanekileyo.

lessons.body:
# Phinda: ukuhlaziya ikota 12

Wenze kakuhle! Ugqibe izifundo ezisi-7 zekota yeshumi elinesibini.

Kule veki **akukho sifundo sitsha**. Imibuzo yale veki ivela kwizifundo zale kota. Ukuba awuqinisekanga, buyela kwizifundo uzifunde kwakhona phambi kokuba uqale.

---

# Esiyifundileyo kule kota

1. Ukwahlulwa kwesiqingatha (halving)
2. Yintoni i-mempool?
3. Intlawulo ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni
4. Iibhloko, i-blockchain nokuqinisekiswa
5. Kutheni i-Bitcoin? Ilixa lokukhonya
6. Ii-CBDC: zintoni, zilawulwa ngubani?
7. Ii-CBDC ne-Bitcoin: umahluko

> Ukuphinda kunceda ukuba ukhumbule. Phendula ezi-3 kwemi-4 ngokuchanekileyo.
